name: What should I prepare before an accessible bathroom remodeling consultation?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before an accessible bathroom remodeling consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before scheduling your initial consultation, take note of specific daily challenges and mobility aids used, such as walkers, manual wheelchairs, or transfer benches. Measure your current mobility equipment width and list key priorities, such as seated showering, grab bar positions, or an easy-reach vanity. Having this list ready helps HH Remodeling LLC plan framing modifications, subfloor transitions, and plumbing placements accurately. Owner Abraham Becerra reviews these practical details on-site to design a layout that aligns with your household needs and structural layout.
acceptedAnswer.description: List daily physical challenges, measure any mobility devices in use, and note preferred fixture locations to help plan framing and layout adjustments.
